a:

there is no such thing as a XXXXX process.  however, a bacterium or fungus does not necessarily need to be XXXXX because it can be an endosymbiont (a symbiont is an organism which inhabits another organism).  the reason that we say that there is a XXXXX process in bacteria is because we are describing an endosymbiotic relationship, where the bacteria are symbionts to the host.  one can even say that there are symbiotic relationships without there being an endosymbiont.  this can be done because a symbiosis is an interaction between two organisms wherein one is not needed for the other.  the two forms of communication would be endosymbiosis and rh
